model_contract.equilibrium_baseline: Two formation yields against sugar uptake; equilibrium Morakul/Mouret transfer; instantaneous capture.
model_contract.delayed_biological_response: Baseline plus a smooth gamma-shaped post-pulse formation yield with fitted peak time.
model_contract.line_reservoir: Baseline production plus a mass-conserving first-order gas-line reservoir before capture.
model_contract.delayed_response_plus_reservoir: Delayed biological formation and gas-line reservoir jointly.

validation_policy.selection_rule: simplest model passing all species/domain guardrails; otherwise no validated model

data_quality_policy.reason: Common six-analyte spike at 144 h; raw chromatogram and independent duplicate unavailable. Retained because paired condensate also peaks and similar common spikes occur elsewhere.

interpretation_limits.activation_peak: Pulse time and temperature transition are confounded in protocol A; activation_peak_h is delayed biological activation, not a uniquely identified nitrogen-response time.
interpretation_limits.line_reservoir: A fitted time constant above an engineering residence-time measurement is phenomenological and cannot be labeled physical line holdup.
interpretation_limits.external_validation: All six runs have informed model development; leave-one-run-out is retrospective internal validation, not prospective confirmation.
